column1: # VITAL 3.0 reference doses (ED01) - Allergen Bureau, "Recommended Reference Doses",
# Table 1 of the VITAL 4.0 Summary and FAQ, August 2024 (VITAL 3.0 column).
# Values are mg of TOTAL PROTEIN of the allergen.
# Action Limit (ppm) = rfdMg / consumption amount (kg), capped by maxActionPpm when set.
# Cashew and pistachio share one reference dose, as do walnut and pecan.
# Molluscs and buckwheat carry no VITAL 3.0 reference dose: they are deliberately absent
# here and keep the fixed threshold held by the allergen.
# allergenCode must match bcpg:allergenCode on the allergen characteristic.
# proteinPerc is optional: leave it empty when the declared quantity is already
